0.name: TEXT_CMNGSCTRIPLETRIADMATCHING_00370_MATCHING_000_001
0.description: Looking to square off in a rousing battle of Triple Triad? Nothing would give me and my fellow hall assistants greater pleasure than to match you up with a worthy opponent!
0.translation_description: Ti va di cimentarti in un’appassionante partita di Triple Triad? A me e ai miei colleghi della sala farebbe molto piacere trovarti un avversario alla tua altezza!

2.name: TEXT_CMNGSCTRIPLETRIADMATCHING_00370_A1_000_001
2.description: Sign up for standard battle matching.

7.name: TEXT_CMNGSCTRIPLETRIADMATCHING_00370_Q2_000_000
7.description: Sign up for standard battle matching?

13.name: TEXT_CMNGSCTRIPLETRIADMATCHING_00370_A2_000_003
13.description: And...done! We've recorded your name on the matching list. Please remain in the Battlehall, and we will endeavor to find you a suitable opponent as soon as we can!
13.translation_description: Ecco fatto! Abbiamo aggiunto il tuo nome alla lista d’abbinamento. Rimani nella Sala d’Armi e cercheremo un avversario adatto a te non appena possibile!

14.name: TEXT_CMNGSCTRIPLETRIADMATCHING_00370_A5_000_003
14.description: And...done! We've recorded your name on the tournament matching list. Please remain in the Battlehall, and we will endeavor to find you a suitable tourney as soon as we can!
14.translation_description: Ecco fatto! Abbiamo aggiunto il tuo nome alla lista d’abbinamento per i tornei. Rimani nella Sala d’Armi e cercheremo un torneo adatto a te non appena possibile!

18.name: TEXT_CMNGSCTRIPLETRIADMATCHING_00370_A3_000_003
18.description: Had enough for the day? Very well. We've removed your name from the matching list. Next time the urge to do battle strikes, you know where to find us!
18.translation_description: Per oggi hai fatto abbastanza? Va bene. Abbiamo rimosso il tuo nome dalla lista. La prossima volta che ti verrà voglia di duellare, sai dove trovarci!

21.name: TEXT_CMNGSCTRIPLETRIADMATCHING_00370_A4_000_004
21.translation_description: Informazioni sugli abbinamenti per i tornei.

24.name: TEXT_CMNGSCTRIPLETRIADMATCHING_00370_MATCHING_100_001
24.description: In the mood for a rousing Triple Triad battle, but having trouble finding a worthy opponent? Well, you've certainly come to the right place! Simply register with me or one of my fellow hall assistants, and we'll match you up with one of the many seasoned duelists that have come to these halls seeking to do battle.
24.translation_description: Hai voglia di una partita entusiasmante di Triple Triad ma fatichi a trovare un avversario alla tua altezza? Allora sei nel posto giusto! Iscriviti da me o da uno dei miei colleghi della sala: ti faremo sfidare uno dei tanti duellanti esperti che vengono qui per combattere.

25.name: TEXT_CMNGSCTRIPLETRIADMATCHING_00370_MATCHING_100_002
25.description: Register for matching in the Triple Triad Battlehall, and a hall assistant will pair you up with an opponent from among all who have also put their names on the list.
25.translation_description: Iscrivendoti agli abbinamenti nella Sala d’Armi di Triple Triad, un assistente di sala ti abbinerà a uno degli altri giocatori che hanno inserito il proprio nome nella lista.

26.name: TEXT_CMNGSCTRIPLETRIADMATCHING_00370_MATCHING_100_003
26.description: Please note that while signed up for matching, you will be unable to do battle with other adventurers directly. You will, however, still be able to do battle with NPCs.
26.translation_description: Durante l’attesa in lista non potrai sfidare direttamente gli altri avventurieri. Potrai comunque combattere contro i PNG.

27.name: TEXT_CMNGSCTRIPLETRIADMATCHING_00370_MATCHING_100_004
27.description: You can remove your name from the matching list at any time by speaking to a hall assistant, or by selecting the option at the conclusion of a battle against a matched opponent.
27.translation_description: Puoi ritirare l’iscrizione in qualsiasi momento parlandone con un assistente di sala oppure scegliendo l’opzione al termine di una partita contro l’avversario abbinato.

28.name: TEXT_CMNGSCTRIPLETRIADMATCHING_00370_MATCHING_100_005
28.description: If you do not choose to withdraw, you will remain on the matching list to participate in as many battles as you would like.
28.translation_description: Se non ritiri l’iscrizione, resterai in lista e potrai partecipare a tutte le partite che desideri.

29.name: TEXT_CMNGSCTRIPLETRIADMATCHING_00370_MATCHING_200_001
29.description: Before a standard battle against a matched opponent, you will each have the option to select one rule for your match. The two rules will be combined, and the battle will begin!
29.translation_description: Prima di una partita standard contro l’avversario abbinato, ognuno di voi potrà scegliere una regola. Le due regole verranno combinate e poi la partita avrà inizio!

30.name: TEXT_CMNGSCTRIPLETRIADMATCHING_00370_MATCHING_200_002
30.description: In the event that you and your opponent choose conflicting rules─such as “All Open” and “Three Open”─both rules will automatically be switched to “Roulette.”
30.translation_description: Se tu e il tuo avversario scegliete regole incompatibili, per esempio «Tutte Scoperte» e «Tre Scoperte», entrambe verranno sostituite automaticamente da «Roulette».

31.name: TEXT_CMNGSCTRIPLETRIADMATCHING_00370_MATCHING_200_003
31.description: Furthermore, note that if you do not select a rule within the allotted time limit, your choice will default to “No Rule.”
31.translation_description: Inoltre, se non scegli una regola entro il tempo limite, verrà applicata «Nessuna regola».

32.name: TEXT_CMNGSCTRIPLETRIADMATCHING_00370_MATCHING_200_004
32.description: Furthermore, please be aware that for tournaments─as you might expect─tournament rules will apply.
32.translation_description: Per i tornei, come puoi immaginare, si applicano le regole del torneo.

33.name: TEXT_CMNGSCTRIPLETRIADMATCHING_00370_MATCHING_300_001
33.description: Looking to experience the thrill and excitement that can only be found in a rousing Triple Triad tournament? Rest assured that you're not alone! Here in the Battlehall, it would be our distinct pleasure to find like-minded duelists and match you up in a tourney that is sure to test your skills and afford you the opportunity to earn rich rewards should you emerge victorious!
33.translation_description: Vuoi provare l’emozione di un avvincente torneo di Triple Triad? Non sei il solo! Qui alla Sala d’Armi saremo lieti di trovare altri duellanti appassionati come te e di organizzare una sfida che metta alla prova le tue abilità e ti offra ricchi premi in caso di vittoria!

34.name: TEXT_CMNGSCTRIPLETRIADMATCHING_00370_MATCHING_300_002
34.description: Sign up for tournament matching, and you will be matched with other adventurers in the Battlehall with whom who you can do battle in Triple Triad tournaments.
34.translation_description: Iscrivendoti agli abbinamenti per i tornei, verrai associato ad altri avventurieri della Sala d’Armi con cui sfidarti nei tornei di Triple Triad.

35.name: TEXT_CMNGSCTRIPLETRIADMATCHING_00370_MATCHING_300_003
35.description: Please note that while signed up for matching, you will be unable to do battle with other adventurers directly. You will also be ineligible to participate in tournaments.
35.translation_description: Durante l’attesa in lista non potrai sfidare direttamente gli altri avventurieri. Inoltre, non potrai partecipare ai tornei.

36.name: TEXT_CMNGSCTRIPLETRIADMATCHING_00370_MATCHING_300_004
36.description: You can remove your name from the matching list at any time by speaking to a hall assistant, or by selecting the option at the conclusion of a battle against a matched opponent.
36.translation_description: Puoi ritirare l’iscrizione in qualsiasi momento parlandone con un assistente di sala oppure scegliendo l’opzione al termine di una partita contro l’avversario abbinato.

37.name: TEXT_CMNGSCTRIPLETRIADMATCHING_00370_MATCHING_300_005
37.description: If you do not choose to withdraw, you will remain on the matching list to participate in as many battles as you would like.
37.translation_description: Se non ritiri l’iscrizione, resterai in lista e potrai partecipare a tutte le partite che desideri.

38.name: TEXT_CMNGSCTRIPLETRIADMATCHING_00370_MATCHING_300_006
38.description: If you participate in even a single tournament, you will automatically be escorted to Card Square so that your ranking can be recalculated.
38.translation_description: Se partecipi anche a un solo torneo, verrai accompagnato automaticamente alla Piazza delle Carte per aggiornare la tua posizione in classifica.

39.name: TEXT_CMNGSCTRIPLETRIADMATCHING_00370_MATCHING_300_007
39.description: You will also be escorted from the Battlehall once it reaches fifteen minutes (Earth time) before the end of the tournament period.
39.translation_description: Quando mancheranno quindici minuti (ora terrestre) alla fine del torneo, verrai accompagnato fuori dalla Sala d’Armi.
